112.label: rescue service and fire brigade
112.scope: acute or potentially life-threatening emergencies, fire, smoke, explosion, suspected gas release

110.label: police
110.scope: active crime, violence, or police danger

116117.label: medical on-call service
116117.scope: urgent medical problems that cannot wait but are not life-threatening

116123.label: TelefonSeelsorge
116123.scope: confidential crisis conversation; acute danger remains 112

gas_network.label: local gas-network emergency service
gas_network.scope: gas odour or suspected network fault; call only from outside

115.label: public-administration information line
115.scope: identifies the responsible public authority; not an emergency or guaranteed-accommodation line

116016.label: violence against women helpline
116016.scope: confidential support for women affected or threatened by violence and people supporting them

men_violence_help.label: violence against men helpline
men_violence_help.scope: anonymous support for men affected by violence and people supporting them; published service hours apply

116111.label: child and youth helpline
116111.scope: anonymous support for children and young people; published service hours apply

women_shelter_search.label: nationwide women’s refuge search
women_shelter_search.scope: directory and availability hints; placement must be confirmed directly and the directory is not complete

municipal_emergency_housing.label: municipal emergency accommodation / homelessness service
municipal_emergency_housing.scope: local authority responsible for emergency accommodation; day and after-hours routes vary

accessible_emergency_place.label: accessible emergency accommodation or powered care destination
accessible_emergency_place.scope: locally confirmed destination matching mobility, communication, medication, power, caregiver, child, or animal needs

youth_emergency_service.label: local youth emergency service / Jugendnotdienst
youth_emergency_service.scope: local child-protection and safe-place route outside ordinary office hours
